overall_notes: The paper presents ABSEval, a novel agent-based framework for evaluating script generation from LLMs. The extraction was largely accurate but contained some duplicates and inconsistent naming. Key findings: - Script generation/planning is the main NLG task - MCScript dataset with 1,500+ script tasks - ABSEval framework outperforms traditional metrics and single-LLM evaluation - Comprehensive evaluation of 15 LLMs across 7 script quality criteria
